'''Helen Goldenfield''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] rancher who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wait a second. I guess you don't look like a pirate or thug. I'm sorry. I'm so riled up I can hardly think straight. Look, I could use your help with this. My husband has left to contact the authorities. I need to go calm down or I may do something drastic. Please, go down the stairs and keep an eye on those thugs for me. It would really help me out.|Helen Goldenfield, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Helen Goldenfield lived in a [[The Ranch|ranch]] near the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with her husband [[Roric Goldenfield]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

[[File:Tatooine_ranch.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[The Ranch]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Helen and her husband had raised the ire of a local band of [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]] who had established a [[Pirate Base|hideout]] near their home. Roric had managed to capture and imprison two of the pirates, [[Arian Vh'ra]] and [[Itr Fairla]], in the basement of their home and had left to find an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] to have them arrested. He left Helen to watch the pirates. While he was away, a [[Hero of Tatooine|spacer]], who was on a [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|quest]] for the [[Mark of Honor]], arrived at their house. Being a gracious host, Helen let the spacer in. She asked if they would watch the prisoners for her while she took a break. The spacer agreed. During this time, the pirates pleaded with the spacer to let them out, but they refused and informed Helen of their intent to escape. At this time, Roric had finally returned with two Imperial [[Exogen-class dark trooper|dark troopers]]. The troopers arrested the pirates and led them out of the house. Helen and her husband thanked the spacer for their assistance, and the spacer left.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanFemale.png|thumb|right|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Helen Goldenfield]]
Helen Goldenfield was an non-playable character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Helen Goldenfield was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref>

Because Helen Goldenfield spawned under the generic "commoner_human_female" template, her appearance was randomized under one of twelve possible depictions. She appeared consistently a Human female, however.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the "Honor" portion involving the Goldenfield family was not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
